# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Invented learning-garden trial records supplied in the public synthetic fixture
- Reports a learner recall outcome
- Any year, English

## Exclusion criteria
- Records outside the supplied fixture
- No recall outcome

## Query log
- 2026-10-07 | invented-index (supplied fixture fixture-001.json) | 2 records. No live backend searches run because all records are synthetic.

## Screening
- amber (Lumen, 2024): included, reports recall outcome
- ivory (Vale, 2024): included, reports recall outcome
The amber garden trial reported 6.4% stronger recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial reported 6.4% stronger recall (Vale, 2024).
